profile.org_note: Family-owned, run by CEO David Drees (third generation) with President Tim Terrell (ex-CFO, ex-Kroger finance) running operations and growth. Regional presidents (Scott Drees in the Midwest, Randy Mickle in the Southeast) oversee division presidents, and each division president owns land acquisition locally with division land acquisition and development managers. No corporate CFO, land head or treasurer is named publicly since Terrell's 2024 promotion; Daniel Preston is the Secretary/Treasurer of record on 2026 state filings. Terrell is the senior finance and capital contact.
profile.summary: Ranked about No. 37 in the US and No. 18 among private builders (company, May 2026). A 98-year-old family builder across 12 metros in 8 states, focused on move-up and semi-custom buyers, with townhome, Pure Style and build-on-your-lot lines. Its Centennial Strategy targets about 4,000 homes a year by 2028 (from 2,400 in 2024) and 300 closings per division. Growth so far has come from acquisition (Monticello Homes, San Antonio, January 2025) and greenfield entry (Columbus, 2026), and management says it will buy established builders where it can.

people.name: David Drees
people.title: Chief Executive Officer
people.source_title: Texas Comptroller franchise-tax public information report, Drees Builders, Inc. (report year 2026)
people.note: Grandson of founder Theodore Drees; CEO since 2000 per the company 95th-anniversary post. The 2026-06-05 Drees release (https://www.dreeshomes.com/press-news/drees-homes-earns-top-national-customer-experience-honors-with-avidcx-recognition/) quotes him as 'President and CEO'; the 2026-06-05 HousingWire/Builder's Daily caption calls him Chairman. Treat Terrell as President for operating matters. Title note: Company releases style him President and CEO.
